findings.summary: The NestedRepeat ReDoS heuristic is bypassed by nested or alternation shapes such as ((a+))+ and (a|aa)+$
findings.scenario: User enables regex and types ((a+))+$ or (a|aa)+$ against a long run of a's: the guard does not match, test() backtracks exponentially and freezes the renderer until restart (no longer persisted, so only on deliberate input).
